segments.description: Manufactures component products for RV, marine, powersports, manufactured housing and industrial OEM customers.
segments.evidence: The Company operates within two reportable segments, Manufacturing and Distribution, through a nationwide network of manufacturing and distribution centers for its products

segments.name: Distribution
segments.description: Distributes building and component products, plus transportation and logistics services, to RV, marine, powersports, MH and industrial customers.
segments.evidence: The Manufacturing and Distribution segments accounted for 74% and 26%, respectively, of the Company's consolidated net sales for the year ended December, 31, 2025.

revenueModel.text: The company is paid primarily by RV, marine, powersports, manufactured housing and industrial OEMs and manufacturers for the component products and distribution services it sells them.
revenueModel.evidence: The Company's RV products are sold primarily to major RV original equipment manufacturers ("OEMs"), smaller OEMs, and to a lesser extent, manufacturers in adjacent industries.
